entry.title: New: dsh-task-worktree
entry.summary: Complete task-scoped git worktrees for DSH: per-repo manifest for durable state, branch-and-path names (slashes allowed, e.g. refactor/logging), bring-back to main or direct commit, optional carry-over of uncommitted main changes. Exact install spec: github:letter2025/dsh-task-worktree. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
